findings.text: the clause says a name of the pair that `sn-definitions-by-construction` §6 "has already brought onto the ruled spelling is recorded as settled only where that edit was the history-apart reclaim with its archive receipt", but that section's declared routes are §2's wording, §3's unit spelling and §5's name-against-definition dispositions through the signed rename path, so no edit it makes can be the history-apart reclaim; the settlable branch is unreachable by the actor it names, and a name the reclaim has legitimately settled before §6 runs would be reported to the lead as a revived tombstone instead of recorded

findings.reason: a reclaim that archives the successor edge and a supersede written back onto the reclaimed identity can leave a two-tip or chained lineage that no clause in the section can catch, so a node could satisfy every named measure and still leave the lineage narrating the same quantity twice.
